answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet as a result collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the shale graph is rebuilt each epoch, the kernel merge is applied at settlement and the mirror audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 43 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 11 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
